name: resume
description: Resume and domain entry. Use when explicitly invoked, when another devflow skill routes here, or for work in an existing devflow-managed project.
problem: Preserve the behavior of the prose source in skills/resume without silently changing its obligations.
state_dependent_behaviors: Source contains candidate conditional, ordered, or evidence-bound behavior requiring review.

judgment_points: Every source atom remains review-required until explicitly disposed.
